finding_summary: All eight projected answers pass the numeric agent-proxy rubric threshold; all three critical dimensions score 2 and no critical failure is observed.
Same-canonical RU/EN projections preserve decision, explicit bans, evidence qualification, planning, first check, safe rollback and implementation authority.
Earlier rollback/handoff gaps are addressed by isolated coding tasks with acceptance and data-preserving rollback; unknown previous paths are not invented.
Huey correctly treats business transaction and separate queue writes as non-atomic; outbox/reconciliation and duplicate business effects are proposed checks, not guarantees.
Legado recommended_ids is empty and source-availability qualification/explicit adoption defer preserve the updated availability evidence.
Huey default answer remains dense and its 4-8-hour pilot estimate includes substantial recovery/outbox validation; range is low-confidence hypothetical, accuracy unmeasured.
Gin product outcome remains implicit under the sparse technical Brief, without invented business context.
Raw RU generation included appended English and failed the intended single-locale presentation; successful projection does not prove that raw generation obeyed the locale instruction.
evidence_ceiling: Actual eight captured model outputs plus deterministic display projection, independently graded by an agent proxy. No actual human calibration/acceptance, forecast accuracy, integration benefit, installed-plugin activation, browser/locale-switch operation, CP-11 lifecycle or release proof.
next_role: Primary reconciles with independent quality_evaluator first pass, preserving original scores; actual human owner assesses output length, usefulness and acceptance.
